WEG is the largest industrial electric motor manufacturer in the Americas and one of the largest manufacturers of electric motors in the world producing more than 21 million units annually. About This Role WEG Electric Corp. has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Service Engineering Specialist to join our Low Voltage Motors team in Duluth, GA. The Senior Service Engineering Specialist provides intermediate-level technical support for WEG products, including LV Drives, Soft Starters, PLCs, HMIs, and basic MV, DC, and System Drive applications. This role supports customers, distributors, and field service personnel through troubleshooting, diagnostics, programming support, and technical problem resolution. Support is provided primarily through phone, email, and remote connection, with occasional limited field support when required. The ideal candidate has experience working with industrial automation, motor control systems, variable frequency drives, and electrical troubleshooting. This position serves as a key technical resource while partnering with customers, field service engineers, engineering, quality, and product management teams to deliver effective solutions and ensure customer satisfaction. Primary Responsibilities Provide technical support via phone, email, and remote connection for WEG LV Drives, Soft Starters, PLCs, HMIs, and basic MV/DC/System Drive applications. Troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex electrical, control, programming, and communication issues. Perform structured remote diagnostics to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions. Evaluate support cases to determine when on-site intervention is required and coordinate escalation to Field Service or Senior Support Engineers. Support Field Service Engineers by providing technical guidance, wiring diagrams, parameter recommendations, and troubleshooting assistance before and during site visits. Document customer interactions, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions within technical support systems. Assist with product evaluations, testing activities, warranty validation, and technical issue investigations. Identify product non-conformities and collaborate with Engineering and Quality teams to support corrective actions. Provide field feedback to Product Management and Engineering teams to support continuous product improvement. Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-base resources. Assist with customer training activities and support onboarding of new technical support team members. Participate in after-hours support rotation as required. Support customers with repair recommendations, return authorizations, and parts identification. Maintain current knowledge of WEG products, applications, and emerging technologies. Deliver a high level of customer service while managing escalated customer situations professionally. Education Associate degree or technical certification preferred Experience & Knowledge 3 to 7 years of experience supporting industrial automation, motor control systems, drives, controls, electrical systems, or related technologies. Solid understanding of LV Drives, Soft Starters, motors, and industrial electrical systems. Familiarity with MV Drives, DC Drives, and System Drive applications. Working knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, and industrial communication networks such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus, DeviceNet, and BACnet. Understanding of AC/DC motor control, power electronics, and control logic. Experience utilizing diagnostic software, test equipment, and remote support platforms. Knowledge of applicable safety standards including NFPA 70E, NEC, and OSHA requirements. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Ability to interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Ability to work independently with moderate supervision and collaboratively within a team environment. Professional customer service skills, including the ability to support escalated customer situations. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Location : Duluth, GA On-site, Monday through Friday We offer a pleasant work environment, competitive compensation and full benefits package. To Apply: All candidates must submit an updated resume and complete our application in order to be considered for this position. Must be authorized to work in the United States. WEG does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, disability, veteran, or other protected status.

review_candidates.title: Product Manager - Data & AI
review_candidates.description: About Soum Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom. About The Role Every transaction on Soum generates valuable data: device conditions, car histories, prices, demand signals, and buyer behaviour. The Data & AI Product Manager turns that data into a competitive advantage. You will own the products that price used items accurately, detect fraud, automate inspection and grading, personalise discovery, and give every team at Soum a reliable source of truth. This is not a role for someone who manages data products from a distance. You will understand data as deeply as a data engineer, comfortable writing SQL, reviewing data models and challenging pipeline designs, while bringing the commercial judgement to decide which problems are worth solving and the drive to get them into production. Key Responsibilities Define and own the Data & AI product roadmap, with every initiative tied to a clear commercial outcome such as GMV, margin, conversion, operating cost or fraud loss. Lead pricing and valuation products for used electronics and cars, including instant quotes for sellers, price recommendations and dynamic pricing based on condition, demand, seasonality and market trends. Identify, size and ship AI/ML use cases across the business, such as search ranking and recommendations, fraud and risk scoring, image-based condition grading, LLM-powered listing creation, and Arabic/English customer support automation. Own the data platform as a product: work with data engineering on pipelines, data models, the warehouse and event tracking, with clear standards for data quality, lineage, documentation and access. Stay hands-on with the data: write SQL, explore datasets, spec tracking schemas and data contracts, review data models, and validate that what is built matches what the business needs. Translate business problems into well-defined ML and analytics problem statements, defining offline and online evaluation metrics, success criteria and guardrails with data scientists and ML engineers. Build business cases and make build-vs-buy decisions (for example third-party LLM APIs versus in-house models), including ROI, inference and infrastructure costs. Drive adoption of data products across Commercial, Operations, Finance and leadership, including self-serve analytics, trusted KPI definitions and dashboards people actually use. Monitor models and data products after launch for performance, drift, data quality and business impact, and iterate quickly when results fall short. Ensure responsible and compliant use of data and AI, in line with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and SDAIA guidance, with appropriate privacy, human-in-the-loop and bias controls. Explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership, and build alignment around priorities. Requirements 2-4 years of product management experience, with significant time spent on data platforms, ML/AI products or data-intensive products. Data depth comparable to a data engineer: advanced SQL, data modelling (dimensional / star schema), ETL/ELT, event tracking, and familiarity with modern data stacks (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift; dbt; Airflow; Kafka). Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle and modern GenAI: problem framing, feature engineering, model evaluation, MLOps, and LLM techniques such as RAG, prompt design and working with vendor APIs. Strong commercial acumen, with a track record of linking data or AI products to revenue, margin or cost outcomes and building convincing business cases. Has shipped AI/ML or data products into production and can show measurable impact, not just prototypes. Ability to drive products forward independently: setting direction, unblocking teams, and making fast, well-reasoned decisions. Excellent communication skills, able to move comfortably between engineers, data scientists and commercial leaders. Fluent English; Arabic is a plus. Nice to Have Prior experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer or data scientist before moving into product. Experience with pricing engines, marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or fintech risk and fraud. Experience with computer vision or Arabic NLP use cases. Familiarity with PDPL, data governance frameworks or the GCC data regulatory landscape. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
